"""BFT consensus vote messages."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class CommitVote:
    view: int
    sequence: int
    block_hash: str
    node_id: str

tests.test_bft_quorum.py:
from bft_message import CommitVote
from bft_engine import BFTEngine
from validator_set import ValidatorSet


def test_validator_set_size_and_membership():
    vs = ValidatorSet(["v1", "v2", "v3"])
    assert vs.size == 3
    engine = BFTEngine(vs)
    assert engine.receive_vote(CommitVote(1, 1, "blk", "unknown")) is False


def test_four_node_cluster_requires_three_votes():
    # N=4 (f=1) requires 2f+1 = 3 votes for finality
    vals = ["v0", "v1", "v2", "v3"]
    vs = ValidatorSet(vals)
    engine = BFTEngine(vs)
    # 2 votes must NOT finalize block
    assert engine.receive_vote(CommitVote(1, 1, "blk_a", "v0")) is False
    assert engine.receive_vote(CommitVote(1, 1, "blk_a", "v1")) is False
    # 3rd vote reaches 2f+1 quorum -> finalized
    assert engine.receive_vote(CommitVote(1, 1, "blk_a", "v2")) is True


def test_seven_node_cluster_requires_five_votes():
    # N=7 (f=2) requires 2(2)+1 = 5 votes
    vs = ValidatorSet([f"v_{i}" for i in range(7)])
    assert vs.required_commit_quorum() == 5
